scenarios.name: retiree, all retirement income subtracted
scenarios.source: IL-1040 Line 5: federally taxed Social Security and retirement income from qualified employee benefit plans (including 401(k) and IRA distributions) included in AGI is subtracted directly on Line 5, not Schedule M (claiming it on Schedule M double-subtracts it and triggers a DOR notice). Flat rate 4.95% per IL-1040 line 12.
